px4_line: Stock upstream PX4 at the exact commit the DEXI-5 v1 ARK Pi6X was already running (v1.15.0-4-gdd5e81470c, release/1.15, NuttX 5d74bc1389), plus ONE added Kconfig line. Built at that commit deliberately so the uXRCE-DDS message set stays identical to the companion px4_msgs the Pi expects.
modification: CONFIG_DRIVERS_MAGNETOMETER_ISENTEK_IST8310=y added to boards/ark/pi6x/default.px4board. Nothing else changed.
why: The stock ark/pi6x build ships only MMC5983MA + IIS2MDC (both internal to the carrier) and no external mag driver at all, because ARK expects external sensors over DroneCAN. The DEXI-GPS daughterboard is UART + I2C and carries an IST8310 at 0x0E, which answers on I2C bus 1 but had no driver: 'nsh: ist8310: command not found'. Outdoor GPS position hold needs a usable heading source, and the only enumerated compass is the carrier-internal IIS2MDC, which was failing preflight with 'Strong magnetic interference'.
build_note: Local build, not from cloud GHA / R2, so there is no firmware_url. Built in a throwaway git worktree with a pinned toolchain: Python 3.12, cmake 3.31.6 (system cmake 4.x rejects libuavcan's cmake_minimum_required(2.8.11)), setuptools 75.8.0 (84.x dropped pkg_resources, which the DroneCAN DSDL compiler imports).
how_to_tell_it_is_flashed: 'ver all' reports 'PX4 git-branch: ark/pi6x-ist8310-1.15' where a stock build says 'release/1.15'. Note the version NUMBER is identical either way (1.15.0, git-hash dd5e81470c), so check the branch line, not the version. The functional check is 'ist8310 status' in the MAVLink shell: stock returns 'nsh: ist8310: command not found'.
flash_verified: 2026-08-11: FLASHED AND VERIFIED on the DEXI-5 v1 at 192.168.68.51 via flash_px4.sh over ssh. Board id 58 matched, erase/program/verify 100%, 28.0s, mavlink-router came back active. Confirmed after reboot: 'ist8310 status' shows it running on I2C bus 1 addr 0x0E with 0 bad registers and 0 bad transfers; 'listener sensor_mag -i 1' publishes device_id 396809 (Type 0x06 = IST8310, I2C:1 0x0E) with error_count 0. Param set survived intact: 1028 before, 1044 after, ZERO lost, the 16 new ones are all CAL_MAG1_* slots auto-created for the newly detected second mag, plus _HASH_CHECK. NOT YET compass-calibrated (CAL_MAG1_ID still 0, CAL_MAG1_PRIO -1) and NOT flight tested.
flash_headroom_note: 1686364 / 1835008 bytes = 91.9% of the image budget, roughly 145 KB free. Adding further drivers to this board config may not fit.
